research_question: Can real spacecraft telemetry and labels be reconstructed?
control_population: Telemetry outside event windows; not nominally certified
control_semantics: Labels identify recorded events; unlabelled is not nominal
primary_result: 200 event IDs; 76 metadata channels; 26 reconstructed in available workspace
limitation: 76 metadata channels vs 26 reconstructed telemetry channels
supports_claims: Real telemetry reconstruction and auditable research workflow

control_semantics: Class-3 metadata labels; not a learned label
primary_result: 30 multivariate events; global/local metadata; impulsive through persistent; up to 26 channels
failure_mode: Small labeled positive population; partial telemetry

research_question: How does immutable v1 behave on initial controls?
control_semantics: Negative controls are not proven nominal
selection_protocol: Frozen thresholds and formulas; pre-existing evaluation
main_finding: High recall with substantial moderate-evidence control detections
failure_mode: Duration, dimensionality, synchrony and scale confounding
supports_claims: Initial v1 behavior on ESA controls

dataset: Frozen v1 evaluation and channel outputs
primary_result: Longer windows, high channel counts, recurring groups, synchrony and scale fallbacks recur
main_finding: Failure modes are measurable and testable
failure_mode: Causal diagnosis and nominality remain unsupported
limitation: Channel-level strong fraction incomplete in source audit

research_question: Do regime-aware controls alter the observed v1 behavior?
primary_result: Same primary structure; controls show long/persistent, dimensionality and synchrony effects
secondary_results: Strong-only materially lowers FPR but loses one positive
main_finding: Control construction confirms confounding is not isolated to one sampling set
failure_mode: Regime, duration, channel count and scale remain confounded
limitation: Small control sample and label-negative status

research_question: Which independent features differ between positives and controls?
dataset: ESA Class-3, matched/random controls, selected telemetry
primary_result: Robust deviation, persistence, channel count and synchrony differ descriptively
main_finding: Features suggest hypotheses but remain confounded
failure_mode: 26 reconstructed channels and insufficient telemetry rows

research_question: Does an interpretable v2 resolve v1 failure modes?
selection_protocol: Pre-registered fixed v2 formula; no threshold tuning
primary_result: v2 TP=29, FP=22, TN=38, FN=1; did not reduce FP and lost one positive
secondary_results: Ablations are descriptive; high-dimensional bias remained
main_finding: v2 is a controlled negative/limited result, not a replacement
limitation: Small sample and no nominal external validation

research_question: What is the broader label-negative population like?
control_semantics: Not normal, nominal or true negative
selection_protocol: 600-second guard; deterministic non-Class3 duration/channel templates; no detector scores
primary_result: 200 labeled; 170 controls; zero overlap; 26/76 telemetry channels
secondary_results: 215 good and 155 insufficient rows in 370-row table
main_finding: Broader stress population exposes coverage and confounding limitations

research_question: How does frozen v1 behave on 170 broader controls?
control_semantics: Not proven nominal; metrics are label-negative-control metrics
selection_protocol: All predetermined controls; frozen v1 score and classification; no retuning
main_finding: Useful but limited broader stress evaluation
limitation: Only 26/76 channels; controls unlabelled; sparse strata

research_question: Does the ESA-style robust protocol transfer to OPSSAT-AD?
positive_population: 434 anomalous segments in test; 113 anomalous test segments
control_population: 1689 nominal segments in dataset; test split protocol
control_semantics: Dataset labels are benchmark labels; not ESA Class-3 semantics
selection_protocol: Train-nominal per-channel robust protocol; 99th percentile threshold; separate experiment
failure_mode: Not semantically valid direct v1 validation
limitation: Different channels, fragmentation and label semantics
